previous.description: 2dog is Godot in .NET! This is the 2dog .NET Tool. `dnx 2dog new MyGame` interactively creates a Godot project with .NET hosts; `2dog add` adds hosts (desktop, browser-wasm, xUnit, NUnit, GdUnit, WinForms, WinUI 3, Avalonia, Qt Quick, Blazor, Android, iOS, MAUI) to an existing one; every prompt has a flag, so `2dog new MyGame --generic --xunit` runs unattended. `2dog doctor` checks the project and the machine, applies safe fixes and explains build failures; `2dog update` brings the 2dog packages to the tool's versions. `2dog pack list` inspects an exported .pck. `dotnet new install 2dog.templates` provides the `dotnet new 2dog` project template. The engine library itself is the 2dog.engine package.
